3109677.title: Andong Cherry Blossom Festival
3109677.overview: Andong's spring festival timed to the bloom along the Nakdong riverside and downtown cherry roads: blossom tunnels, night lighting, street performances, flea markets, and food zones at the Mask Dance Park.

969709.title: Okcheon Sapling Festival
969709.overview: Korea's only nursery-tree district — 90 years of sapling growing in Okcheon — gives away 20,000 saplings and runs auctions, exhibitions, and consultations for gardeners: landscaping trees, houseplants, and kitchen-garden stock straight from the growers.

2620577.title: Seoul International Buddhism Expo
2620577.overview: Korea's flagship Buddhist culture fair at COEX since 2013, paired with the Buddha Art Fair: temple food, meditation goods, craft, and contemporary Buddhist art — this year playfully themed on the concept of emptiness (gong). Free with pre-registration.

2536122.title: Gangseo Nakdonggang 30-ri Cherry Blossom Festival
2536122.overview: Busan Gangseo's riverside blossom festival at Daejeo Eco Park: blossom walks, pungmul parades, K-pop dance and busking stages, family and kids zones, food trucks, and flea markets along the Nakdong River petals.

2953096.title: Gimje Flower Light Festival
2953096.overview: A downtown spring festival in Gimje pairing flower displays by day with a light garden by night — this year styled as a springtime amusement park ('Flower Light Land') with performances, flea markets, and photo zones.

3492561.title: Manseokgeo New Light Festival
3492561.overview: A night festival at Manseokgeo — the Joseon-era reservoir listed as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure — opening Suwon's 2026 visit-year: a combined drone-fireworks-musical fountain show (500 drones, two fireworks rounds) with six busking stages.

3109655.title: Boeun Cherry Blossom Road Festival
3109655.overview: Spring on the Bocheongcheon blossom road in Boeun: busking, bubble-and-magic shows, picnic zones under the trees, and community blossom walks along the stream.

3483727.title: Seodaemun Spring Light Festival
3483727.overview: Three thousand cherry trees on Ansan mountain plus the Hongje waterfall — Seoul's urban cascade — host spring concerts, madang plays, a singing contest, family musicals, daily busking, and month-long blossom lighting along the Hongjecheon.

3011948.title: Yangjae Art Salon
3011948.overview: A rolling weekend culture series on the Yangjaecheon stream: sunset busking stages, craft markets and art workshops along the path, a lawn healing lounge with book corner, and food trucks under Yeongdong Bridge — new themes weekly through the season.

4046353.title: Yeonje Ancient Tombs Fantasy Festival
4046353.overview: A spring festival around the Yeonsan-dong ancient tomb mounds and Oncheoncheon park in Busan: a royal procession, falling-fire (nakhwa) show, blossom song contest — plus morning coffee raves and random-play dance aimed squarely at younger crowds.

4054884.title: Jangja Lake Cherry Blossom Stroll
4054884.overview: Ten days of blossom strolling around Guri's Jangja Lake: free-flow flower walks on weekdays and a programmed weekend of performances, street art, booths, and visitor events by the water.

2485128.title: Gyeongju Daereungwon Stone Wall Road Festival
2485128.overview: Gyeongju's signature spring scene: cherry blossoms over the stone walls and royal mounds of Daereungwon, with the road fully pedestrianized for the festival. Street arts, nightly blossom lighting, a QR-ordered zero-waste restaurant street, and road playgrounds for kids.

3107440.title: Move Salon: Salon Ground
3107440.overview: An open-air community salon on the Yangjaecheon walking path: taste-based meetups anyone can join — or host — under the bridge by Kant's Walk, a city hideout for unwinding with neighbors.

3359409.title: Guryong Village Cherry Blossom Festival
3359409.overview: Blossoms and night lights along the Dongsam seawater stream on Yeongdo, Busan — 'Guryong nights, light and blossom fantasy': lighting ceremony, experience booths, flea markets, busking, and food zones by Amir Park.

1592898.title: Seokchon Lake Cherry Blossom Festival
1592898.overview: A thousand king cherry trees ring Seokchon Lake beneath Lotte World Tower — Seoul's most famous blossom tunnel. The festival adds busking, markets, food trucks, and a full-bloom concert, with night lighting turning the white canopy luminous after dark. Expect crowds; go early or late.

695592.title: Gangneung Gyeongpo Cherry Blossom Festival
695592.overview: Blossoms wrap Gyeongpo Lake all the way to the beach — a drive-and-walk classic since 1993 drawing 250,000 visitors a year. The wetland plaza hosts blossom song contests, picnics, play zones, and a 'catch the blossom thief' event, with evening lights across the lakeshore. Dates track the bloom.

3483016.title: Gangseo Spring Light Festa
3483016.overview: An evening spring festival at Banghwa Park in western Seoul — 'spring light, moonlight, play all night': camping-style rest zones, retro experience booths, and light displays for all ages.

3482354.title: Golche Oreum Cherry Blossom Festival
3482354.overview: A hidden Jeju blossom spot: villagers of Seonheul 2-ri have planted king cherries on Golche Oreum for 20 years, and each April the little volcanic cone turns pink. A gentle two-day village festival with music, home-style food stalls, and easy slopes for all ages.

4046410.title: Blooming Namhae Spring Festival
4046410.overview: Cherry blossoms over the strait where Admiral Yi fell: Namhae's spring festival at Chungnyeolsa Shrine and the Noryang battle site pairs history with drone light shows, fireworks, stamp tours, and flea markets.

3110082.title: Mulgeum Cherry Blossom Festival
3110082.overview: Blossoms along the old Mulgeum rail line and Hwangsan Park — the Nakdong River's biggest waterside park: the blossom road goes car-free for walkers, with exhibitions, experience booths, rest zones, and night landscape lighting.

141647.title: Jecheon Cheongpung Lake Cherry Blossom Festival
141647.overview: The 30th blossom festival on Cheongpung Lake — Jecheon's inland sea: busking and local performances by day, a blossom laser show and open-air cinema by night, with lawn plazas for slow lake-and-petal viewing.

3484079.title: Yangyang Namdaecheon Cherry Blossom Festival
3484079.overview: A quiet-leaning blossom festival on the Namdaecheon in Yangyang: petal walks, lawn concerts, and a full-moon photo zone timed to the lunar 17th — lantern-lit blossom paths completing the spring evening.

2952960.title: Uijeongbu Howon Cherry Blossom Festa
2952960.overview: Uijeongbu's neighborhood blossom festival on the Jungnangcheon: performances and exhibitions under the trees, food booths, flea and sharing markets, and picnic space along the stream.

1592837.title: Trot Festival X Spring Flower Festival
1592837.overview: Dongdaemun-gu pairs its blossom festival with Korea's beloved trot music: local singer competitions, booths, and resident-run food stalls at the Jangan waterside park, with photo zones and night lighting along the Jangan blossom road.

142186.title: Saenggeo Jincheon Nongdari Festival
142186.overview: A spring festival at Nongdari — the thousand-year-old stepping-stone bridge of stacked stones across the Semi River, Korea's oldest surviving stone bridge: performances, exhibitions, and food against Chopyeong Lake scenery.

140736.title: Yudalsan Spring Festival
140736.overview: Mokpo's mountain festival under the spring blossoms of Yudalsan — 'a picnic on a blooming day': slow walks on the ring road, treasure hunts, rock-stacking at Nojeokbong, and rentable picnic sets with harbor views.

2615461.title: Gyeongbokgung Saenggwabang Royal Dessert House
2615461.overview: The royal dessert kitchen of Gyeongbokgung reopens as a tearoom: court sweets and medicinal teas recreated from the Annals, served in the palace's kitchen quarter. The 2026 edition presents storytelling tea tables built on two kings — Yeongjo's austere longevity table and Sukjong's celebratory banquet spread. Ticketed sessions; reserve ahead.

1252849.title: Changnyeong Nakdonggang Canola Festival
1252849.overview: Korea's largest single canola field — 110 hectares of yellow along the Nakdong River at Namji — blooms into Changnyeong's signature spring festival, running since 2006 with performances, orienteering through the flowers, and riverside picnicking.

1907888.title: Busan Urban Agriculture Expo
1907888.overview: A city-farming expo in the canola fields of Daejeo Eco Park: urban growing, healing and companion agriculture, landscape farming exhibitions, and hands-on programs over four spring days.

2828328.title: Seoul Spring Festival
2828328.overview: Seoul's K-lifestyle mega-festival — beauty, fashion, pop, food, art — staged across the Han River itself in 2026: programs on the water and along the banks turn walking the river into the festival experience.

3113469.title: Treasure Island Canola Festival (Gwanmaedo)
3113469.overview: Canola gold on Gwanmaedo — a remote island of the Jindo archipelago reachable only by ferry: 75,000 pyeong of blossom fields with mini-train rides, folk games, island trail walks with forest interpreters, and local stalls by the wharf.

1800991.title: April 19 Revolution National Culture Festival
1800991.overview: A national commemoration of the 1960 April Revolution — the student-led uprising that toppled a rigged election — at the National April 19 Democratic Cemetery: memorials, performances, and citizen programs carrying the movement's values of freedom, democracy, and justice.
1800991.place: National April 19 Cemetery and Gangbuk district

4056086.title: Jinju Strawberry Festival
4056086.overview: Jinju leads Korea's strawberry exports, and its spring festival celebrates the premium Geumsil variety: picking and tastings, sales at farm prices, performances, and family events in the growing heartland of Sugok-myeon.

3482515.title: Sancheong Farm Products Festival
3482515.overview: The medicinal-herb county under Jirisan brings its best to Donguibogam Village: honey, strawberries, herbs, wild greens, and black pork direct from growers, with programs and performances in the herbal-medicine theme park.

3093268.title: Library Day & Library Week
3093268.overview: Korea's national library celebration around April 12: an international conference and hackathon at the National Library, a commemorative ceremony, and campaigns at libraries nationwide in the 62nd library week.
3093268.place: National Library of Korea and libraries nationwide
3093268.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

2842412.title: Donghaeng Festival
2842412.overview: Korea's biggest small-business shopping festival: nationwide discounts and events across traditional markets, local shops, and online platforms, opening with ceremonies in Jeonju — a country-wide campaign rather than a single-venue event.
2842412.place: Opening in Jeonju · nationwide markets and platforms

2740921.title: Korea Science Festival with Busan Science Festival
2740921.overview: The 25th Busan Science Festival joins forces with the national science festival at BEXCO, themed 'the taste of science — AI cooks too': taste-labeled experiment zones, robot and research booths from local universities and institutes, lectures, and shows for families.
2740921.sponsor: Ministry of Science and ICT · Busan

2950952.title: Geumsan Bogok Valley Wild Cherry Festival
2950952.overview: Korea's largest wild-cherry (san-beotkkot) colony — roughly 10 million square meters of hillsides in Bogok Valley — blushes pink each April. Footpaths from 'Boineyo-gil' to 'Jajinbaengi-gil' wind through untouched spring woodland dotted with dogwood, azalea, and wildflowers.

3486026.title: Yeongnangho Cherry Blossom Festival
3486026.overview: Sokcho's lakeside blossom festival: an 8km blossom-tunnel loop around Yeongnang Lake with walking events, lakeside yoga, busking, 40 food and market stalls, and a lit blossom tunnel after dark — with Seoraksan's peaks in the background.

3485660.title: Jayu Park Cherry Blossom Festival
3485660.overview: Incheon's classic blossom spot — Jayu (Freedom) Park above the open port — hosts a spring festival with local and headline stages (past lineups include Jang Yoon-jeong and K.Will), world-DJ sets, pressed-flower crafts, the 1888 art market, and food zones.

3480383.title: Gimpo Cherry Blossom Festival
3480383.overview: Two days of blossoms along the Gyeyangcheon stream — 'purely blossoms': citizen-arts-school ukulele and magic stages, busking, photo zones, and rest spots on Gimpo's favorite petal walk.

4053719.title: Seoul Buramsan Azalea Festival
4053719.overview: A hundred thousand royal azaleas paint Buramsan's healing town pink for one short window each spring: flower-path walks, sensory performances, and family programs at the mountain's foot in northeast Seoul.

2508126.title: Yangju Hoeamsa Temple Site Royal Festival
2508126.overview: Hoeamsa was the greatest temple of late-Goryeo Korea — King Taejo Yi Seong-gye retreated here — and its excavated site is on UNESCO's tentative list. The festival reenacts the royal procession and governor's welcome, with site-mystery quests, bell experiences, heritage performances, temple-food talks, and healing concerts among the ruins.

4056794.title: Busan Spring Flower Exhibition
4056794.overview: Busan Citizens Park in full spring dress — 'Garden Go Round': flower sculptures and topiary, themed beds, bonsai and wildflower special exhibitions, a national flower-tea contest, proposal photo zones, and a growers' market.

4054430.title: Hwasun Spring Flower Festival
4054430.overview: Flower roads by day, 'blossom night walk' by night: Hwasun's spring festival strings canola fields, pop-up pochas, dinosaur installations, and performances along the flower river path and Namsan Park.
4054430.place: Hwasun flower river road and Namsan Park

3486674.title: Gangjin Jeolla Byeongyeongseong Fortress Festival
3486674.overview: A history festival inside the actual walls of Jeolla Byeongyeongseong — the garrison fortress that commanded Jeolla and Jeju for 500 years: soldier-drill reenactments, period costume, and traditional performances along the ramparts.

2849025.title: Namhansanseong World Heritage Programs
2849025.overview: Season-long programs at UNESCO-listed Namhansanseong: palace education experiences, the OUV Expedition storytelling walk along the walls, a climate-protection program for the fortress, and participatory lectures remembering the 1636 siege.

1803449.title: Biseulsan Azalea Festival
1803449.overview: Korea's largest azalea colony — some 300,000 pyeong across Biseulsan's 1,000m summit plateau — turns the mountaintop pink in mid-April. Running since 1997, the festival pairs shuttle-accessible viewing with performances at the mountain base; the summit fields at full bloom are among Korea's great spring sights.

3113152.title: Play Turns Into Science!
3113152.overview: The Incheon Children's Science Museum's Science Day festival: science shows, family challenges, roaming events, robot and AI experiences, and hands-on programs built for kids across the museum.

3484594.title: Seonnong Daeje Royal Farming Rite
3484594.overview: The 47th reenactment of Joseon's royal farming rite at Seonnongdan altar — where kings prayed for good harvests and plowed the first furrow themselves. After the rite and royal procession, the crowd shares seolleongtang from giant cauldrons: the beef soup whose very name, tradition says, comes from this altar.

2594815.title: Queen Jeongsun Culture Festival
2594815.overview: A festival for Queen Jeongsun, who was separated from the deposed boy-king Danjong at eighteen and spent sixty years gazing east toward his exile from Dongmangbong hill. Her story of 'purple longing' becomes a neighborhood festival of remembrance and consolation at Sungin Park.

511801.title: Gochang Green Barley Field Festival
511801.overview: Korea's original landscape-agriculture festival: 770,000 square meters of young green barley waving at Hagwon Farm, drawing 300,000 visitors each spring since 2004. Walk the barley path (3,000 won), browse farm markets, and catch the fields at their photogenic peak from mid-April to mid-May.
511801.fee: Parking 10,000 won (refunded in local currency) · barley path 3,000 won

2953055.title: Reading Korea Campaign Launch
2953055.overview: A World Book Day launch event at COEX's Byeolmadang Library: a mass book-opening performance and message wall kicking off the national reading campaign, with side programs through the weekend.
2953055.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

2608888.title: Gwangju Heritage Night Tour
2608888.overview: The 10th anniversary of Gwangju's heritage night: the '8 nights' format — night views, history tours, crafts, exhibitions, performances, food, market, and stay — around the May 18 Democracy Plaza and the old town's heritage sites.
2608888.place: May 18 Democracy Plaza and heritage sites

292977.title: Gijang Anchovy Festival
292977.overview: Thirty years of spring anchovies at Daebyeon Port: free myeolchi sashimi tastings, boat-fishing trips, surprise seafood auctions, bare-hand fish catching, a song contest, EDM parties, an anniversary parade, and fireworks over the harbor — Busan's definitive taste-of-spring festival.
